template: trade_when(greater(zscore(vec_avg({likelihood_score})), 1.5), winsorize(vec_avg({likelihood_score}) - ts_mean(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 30) * ((vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice})) / ts_mean(vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice}), 30)), std=4), 0)
idea: 高置信条件触发：仅在分析师信心处于极端高位（zscore>1.5）时启用价格偏离信号，低置信区间直接置零。实现"强信号才交易"的区间筛选逻辑，避免中等信心区间的噪音干扰。
